124:t_000:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「First, I'll enter the base and obtain as much information as possible from a terminal.」

124:t_000:5.en:
$$エマ$$
「The rest of us hold the line and intercept enemies approaching $$ティエリア$$ while he's doing that, right?」

124:t_000:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm counting on you to guard $$ティエリア$$, $$刹那$$.」

124:t_000:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Are you sure you'll be okay launching alone, $n...?」

124:t_000:10.en:
$n
「I've received permission from Captain $$アムロ$$. And besides...」

124:t_000:12.en:
$n
「That anxiety you're feeling... I have some idea what it is too.」

124:t_000:14.en:
$n
「It's just as I said in the briefing. ...I'm no longer the person who used to tremble in fear.」

124:t_000:15.en:
$n
「Instead of being afraid of something, I'll step forward myself to overcome it.」

124:t_000:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You can leave the backup to us.」

124:t_000:17.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「When you're that fired up, we can't just leave you on your own.」

124:t_000:18.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Your short-straw instincts are stirring, aren't they, $$ロックオン$$?」

124:t_000:19.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Quit teasing. We're all trying to break through in such a bad situation. We're all in the Short Straw Alliance now.」

124:t_000:20.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're certainly right about that.」

124:t_000:21.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That doesn't mean I intend to end up crying over it.」

124:t_000:22.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The interception forces are coming!」

124:t_001:0.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「There are so many of them...!」

124:t_001:1.en:
$$カツ$$
「It really is the enemy's main base on this continent...!」

124:t_001:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Ha ha ha! Your will to resist must be shriveling, you fools!」

124:t_001:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It's that commander from before...!」

124:t_001:4.en:
$$グラハム$$
「If a man like that is entrusted with command, perhaps this base isn't worth very much.」

124:t_001:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Enough of your insolence! Know that your luck ran out when you waltzed into $$セントラル・ベース$$!」

124:t_001:6.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The $$アンゲロイ$$s at the front are believed to be piloted by $$インセクト$$s!」

124:t_001:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We certainly can't underestimate that formation. And we have another mission to carry out too.」

124:t_001:8.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「I've selected $$アーデ$$'s entry point! It's over there!」

124:t_002:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Everyone, I'm counting on your support!」

124:t_002:3.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「We'll clear away anything blocking your breakthrough!」

124:t_002:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If $$ティエリア$$ doesn't reach the point within four minutes, the operation will fail!」

124:t_002:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, begin the attack! Strike the enemy forces and support $$ティエリア$$'s breakthrough!」

124:t_002:6.en:
$n
「I'll do it...! We will win this battle!」

124:t_003:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$アーデ$$ has reached the point!」

124:t_003:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, support the $$ラファエル$$! Keep the enemy away until $$ティエリア$$ finishes hacking!」

124:t_003:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ティエリア$$!」

124:t_003:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'll extract the Empire's data...! I'll get it, no matter what!」

124:t_004:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Someone interfered while I was hacking...! I can't extract any more data!」

124:t_004:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Watch out, $$刹那$$! Something's coming out of the base!」

124:t_006:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The anxiety I've felt all this time... One part of it is...!」

124:t_008:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It's him...! That man interfered with our hacking!!」

124:t_008:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You've got some skill... But...」

124:t_008:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That will only make you suffer longer.」

124:t_009:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's right, 《$$いがみ合う双子$$》.」

124:t_009:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now... Let your own hatred swallow you.」

124:t_009:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「While the $$いがみ合う双子$$ writhes in hatred, I'll finish introducing myself.」

124:t_009:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「My name is $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

124:t_009:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the '$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$'.」

124:t_009:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're a $$スフィア・リアクター$$...?!」

124:t_009:12.en:
$n
「Guh... Ugh... Aah... Don't come near me!!」

124:t_009:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I heard you took a $$スフィア$$ from $$ガドライト#pilot$$, so I was looking forward to seeing what you could do...」

124:t_009:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're a complete disappointment. Just as $$尸空#pilot$$ said, even that drunkard was better than this.」

124:t_009:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You still had your wits about you...? The $$いがみ合う双子$$ certainly is tenacious.」

124:t_009:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「My $$アン・アーレス$$' poison really works, doesn't it? Now both you and your ugly machine are finished.」

124:t_010:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Lord $$バルビエル$$! I, $$ギルター$$, am coming to you now!」

124:t_011:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Lord $$バルビエル$$! I, $$ギルター$$, am coming to you now!」

124:t_012:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Not a chance! I won't let you interfere with Lord $$バルビエル$$!」
